clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern Barrens, hunters bring back Thunder Lizard Blood as proof of survival. The blood comes from the great beasts that roam the plains.

Thunder lizards go by the names Stormsnouts, Stormhides, and Thunderheads across the plains. Their heavy steps shake the earth, and their crushing weight can flatten unwary hunters. Bringing back their blood shows the skill to hunt them and the endurance to survive beneath their thundering feet.
